package.description: US English keyboard layout with Serbian Latin characters on right ALT key.

en-US.description: US English keyboard layout with Serbian Latin characters on right ALT key.
en-US.longDescription:
A custom keyboard layout that combines the standard US English layout with Serbian Latin characters (č, ć, ž, š, đ).
Ideal for users who type primarily in English but need quick access to Serbian characters without switching input methods.
en-US.name: US-YU Keyboard Layout for Windows 7+
